original_training_task: Binary Deepfake / Face-Swap Detection (0 = Real Face, 1 = Deepfake Face)

reasons: Checkpoint output layer has only 1 binary logit output, specifically calibrated for Deepfake vs Real facial manipulation.
Whole-image AI detection requires discriminating 5 separate forensic categories (REAL, AI_GENERATED, AI_MODIFIED, MANIPULATED, UNKNOWN).
Using a face-swap detector on full scene diffusion images would cause high false-positive rates on real camera photos.
compatibility_assessment.recommendation: PRESERVE this checkpoint exclusively for the Deepfake / Face-Swap Forensic Engine. Build and train a dedicated multi-head 5-class Forensic Classifier for AI-generated and AI-modified image detection.

hardware_recommendation_6gb_vram.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6GB VRAM)
